partners.mechanism_chain: Loss-of-function variant in PARK7 (rs779006469) —DISRUPTS→ PARK7 (HGNC:8676); PARK7 (HGNC:8676) —DISRUPTS→ Oxidative stress response and protein aggregation (GO:0006974); Oxidative stress response and protein aggregation (GO:0006974) —LEADS_TO→ Cellular homeostasis and proteostasis (GO:0008150); Cellular homeostasis and proteostasis (GO:0008150) —LEADS_TO→ Parkinson disease (HP:0001312); Loss-of-function variant in PCNT (rs148675952) —DISRUPTS→ PCNT (HGNC:8777); PCNT (HGNC:8777) —DISRUPTS→ Centrosome function and cell cycle regulation (GO:0000274); Centrosome function and cell cycle regulation (GO:0000274) —LEADS_TO→ Cellular homeostasis and proteostasis (GO:0008150); Cellular homeostasis and proteostasis (GO:0008150) —LEADS_TO→ Microcephaly (HP:0000252); Cellular homeostasis and proteostasis (GO:0008150) —LEADS_TO→ Osteodysplasia (HP:0002720); Cellular homeostasis and proteostasis (GO:0008150) —LEADS_TO→ Primordial dwarfism (HP:0005593). Loss-of-function mutations in PARK7 impair its role in oxidative stress response and protein quality control, leading to protein aggregation and cellular dysfunction characteristic of Parkinson disease.
